questions.q: What does WSL2 actually run on a Windows machine?
options: A command prompt that mimics Linux syntax without a real kernel
A genuine Linux kernel inside a lightweight VM that Windows manages
A remote connection to a cloud-hosted Linux server
A Linux desktop environment with no shell access
questions.explain: WSL2 runs an actual Linux kernel inside a lightweight, Windows-managed virtual machine — not a command-translation layer.

questions.q: Which command installs WSL2 and Ubuntu from an elevated PowerShell prompt?
options: wsl --install
apt install wsl
dnf install wsl2
ssh wsl
questions.explain: wsl --install, run from an elevated PowerShell prompt, installs WSL2 along with a default Ubuntu distribution.

questions.q: Why might the networking and multi-machine lessons later in this course require more than WSL2?
options: WSL2 cannot run any command-line tools
WSL2 shares a kernel with Windows in ways a standalone server never does, so a local VM or cloud instance better represents real networking and boot-process topics
WSL2 is not based on the Linux kernel at all
WSL2 requires a paid Microsoft subscription
questions.explain: WSL2 is great for learning commands quickly, but a local VM or cloud instance behaves like a genuine standalone machine, which matters once networking between machines or the real boot process is the topic.

questions.q: After SSHing into a cloud VM, which command confirms exactly which machine you're logged into?
options: uname -a
hostname
apt update
ssh -V
questions.explain: hostname reports the current machine's name — useful for confirming you're on the remote cloud VM and not still on your own laptop.

questions.q: What is the practical benefit of a free-tier cloud VM over a local VM for later lessons in this course?
options: It costs more money, which guarantees better performance
It's reachable over the real internet, which matters once the course covers remote access and networking
It never needs to be rebooted
It doesn't require an SSH connection
questions.explain: A free-tier cloud VM is reachable over the real internet via SSH, which is genuinely useful once this course's lessons move into remote access and networking topics.
